data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes an 'integration' relation (lapse vs knowledge error taxonomy integrated with an error-cancellation mechanism). But the proposed grounding is tautological and non-substantive: it merely redefines the mechanism's scope to exclude exactly the error class it cannot handle, without establishing a real structural, mechanistic, or causal dependence between the two endpoints. The relation reduces to co-definition, not a substantive integration.
